data.name: Jamilah
data.gender_notes: Jamilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful and lovely name derived from the Arabic word 'jamil' meaning 'beautiful' or 'lovely'. The name Jamilah carries the meaning “Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamilah usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A Muslim girl named Jamilah is said to be blessed with inner beauty and a loving heart.
data.etymology: Jamilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamilah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: جميلة
in_arabic.meaning: جميلة تعني الجمال الحسن والوجه الحسن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جميلة مشتق من الجذر العربي ج-م-ل، ويعني الجمال الحسن والوجه الحسن. ورد ذكر الجمال في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وإذا سألتموه عن الجنة فقولوا الجنة التي عرضها السماوات والأرض'، وقد وردت كلمة جميل وجميلة في الشعر العربي القديم، ويعتبر اسم جميلة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وطيبة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: جمیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: جمیلہ کا مطلب خوبصورت اور حسن چہرہ ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام جمیلہ عربی جڑ ج-م-ل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور حسن چہرہ۔ قرآن کریم میں جمال کی تفصیل کئی آیات میں بیان کی گئی ہے، جن میں سے ایک یہ ہے: 'اور جب تم جنت کے بارے میں پوچھو تو کہو جنت وہ ہے جس کی وسعت آسمانوں اور زمین کے برابر ہے'۔ اردو شاعری میں بھی جمیلہ جیسے الفاظ کا استعمال ہوا ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں جمیلہ جیسے ناموں کو خوبصورت معانی کے حامل سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जमीला
in_hindi.meaning: जमीला का अर्थ है सुंदर और अच्छा चेहरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम जमीला अरबी मूल ज-م-ल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और अच्छा चेहरा। कुरआन में सौंदर्य का उल्लेख कई आयतों में किया गया है, जिनमें से एक यह है: 'और जब तुम स्वर्ग के बारे में पूछो तो कहो स्वर्ग वह है जिसकी चौड़ाई आकाश और पृथ्वी के बराबर है'। हिंदी साहित्य में भी जमीला जैसे शब्दों का प्रयोग हुआ है, और इस्लामी संस्कृति में जमीला जैसे नामों को सुंदर अर्थों के साथ माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جمیلہ
in_pashto.meaning: جمیلہ د ښکلا او نیک چهرې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د جمیلہ نوم د عربي ريښې ج-م-ل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ښکلا او نیک چهرې معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کې د ښکلا تفصیل په ډیرو آیتونو کې بیان شوی دی، په شمول د دې: 'او کله چې تاسو د جنت په اړه پوښتنه کوئ نو ووایاست جنت هغه دی چې د عرض یې د آسمانونو او ځمکې برابر دی'. د پښتو شاعرۍ کې هم د جمیلہ په شان کلماتو کارول شوی دی، او په اسلامي کلتور کې د جمیلہ په شان نومونه د ښکلا معانیو سره ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Jamilah
in_english.meaning: Jamilah means beautiful, lovely, or having a good face
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jamilah is derived from the Arabic root ج-م-ل (j-m-l), which conveys the meanings of beauty, goodness, and pleasantness. The concept of beauty is mentioned in the Quran in several verses, including: 'And when you are asked about Paradise, say: Paradise is that whose breadth is the heavens and the earth' (3:133). In Islamic tradition, Jamilah is considered a name that embodies positive qualities and attributes. The name has been used in Arabic literature and poetry to describe someone with a beautiful face and character. In modern times, Jamilah remains a popular name among Muslim communities worldwide, symbolizing the aspiration for inner and outer beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jamilah is an incredibly popular and beloved name in the Islamic world. It resonates with many Muslim parents due to its association with beauty, not only in terms of physical appearance, but also in beauty of character, kind-heartedness, and moral virtue. In fact, Jamilah is often used as a synonym for the word 'pure' or 'chaste' in traditional poetry and literature. This is a significant imprint on Muslim culture, as it serves as a reminder of the importance of inner beauty and moral virtues, alongside the pursuit of physical beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Jamilah holds deep significance for Muslims as a reminder of the beautiful and loving attributes of God. Muslims believe that God is both Jauli (the one who beautifies) and Jameel (the beautiful one). Jamilah also carries a reference to the beloved Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who was described by the Angel Gabriel as the most beautiful among all mankind. The name Jamilah encourages the individual to strive for inner beauty, moral virtues, as well as maintaining a strong connection to God. It serves as a constant reminder of the beauty of faith and the importance of keeping one's heart pure and radiant with faith. Therefore, Jamilah embodies the ethos of the Islamic faith's emphasis on inner beauty and spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Jamilah bint Harith al-Asadiya was a prominent female poet in the court of the Umayyad caliph Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik (724-743 AD). She is known for her panegyric poetry, which praised the rulers and their accomplishments.
